profile.summary: Sprouts Chef Training is a nonprofit that offers culinary job training to Bay Area youth facing hardship. Trainees are paired with a chef mentor and a case manager to build the skills needed to get and keep a culinary job.

review.notes: Org is in South San Francisco (matches agenda), its site has a trainee page citing OUSD's summer ECCCO program (matches the MOU), and the donate page confirms legal name Sprouts Cooking Club, 501(c)(3), EIN 27-1130990. Summary, email and address are supported by the cited pages and the summary is neutral; 'Bay Area youth' is a mild inference from the South San Francisco base.
